A CLEARER APPLICATION

How Le Resume Studio works

01

Start with your facts

Upload a PDF, Word (.docx), or plain-text master resume. A readable, complete file saves automatically. View its text or remove it with Delete master resume. Change the source file and upload it again to update the master. A new browser starts with this section blank.

02

Match the posting

The app detects terms in the job description, compares them with your resume, focuses the summary, puts relevant skills first, and adjusts equivalent wording in your bullets.

03

Check the evidence

Review supported keywords and gaps. The app uses a keyword catalog and stated-skill detection; you can add keywords it missed. Tools and qualifications without resume evidence stay out of the generated version.

04

Download and apply

Edit your version, then download a single-column Word, PDF, or plain text resume. The 10/10 target requires every detected job phrase to appear with evidence from your resume. The ATS review shows formatting guidance and download checks for your selected platform. Keyword coverage cannot guarantee acceptance or ranking in an employer’s ATS.

Phones, tablets, and browsers

Use a current version of Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge. The layout adapts to your screen and orientation. Paste a full job description, then review both documents.

Choose Word, PDF, or Plain text, then Download file. If Share file is available, it opens your device’s options, including Save to Files on supported devices. Inside ChatGPT, use Open download page first.

If automatic copying is unavailable, the app provides selectable text. Saved versions stay in the browser where you created them. Download a copy to use on another device.

Accessibility and keyboard help

Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through controls. In the review tabs, use Left and Right Arrow, Home, or End to choose a section. Press Escape to close an editor or help dialog.

Use your browser’s zoom and text settings to enlarge content. Scrollable document previews and keyword tables can receive keyboard focus. Motion follows your device’s reduced-motion preference, and no flashing effects are used.

Screen readers can navigate document headings and labeled fields. Choose Plain text if you prefer an export without visual formatting.

Your workspace is private.

Tailoring runs on your device without an AI API. Sections 1 and 2 start blank whenever you open or refresh the app. New users start with an empty master resume. A shared link does not carry your saved master or application history. Masters and saved versions stay in the browser where they were saved. Clear saved versions to delete the application history, or Delete master resume to empty the master.
YOUR DOCUMENT TEXT

Copy resume text

Select the text, then press Control+C on Windows or Command+C on Mac. On a phone or tablet, use the selection menu’s Copy action.

Privacy and password

Your uploads and documents are processed in this browser. Sharing the app link does not share them. Password protection encrypts the master and saved versions on this device and locks them when you reload or close the tab.

Choose a unique passphrase and keep it safe. There is no password recovery or account synchronization. A person using an unlocked browser tab can see its contents. Downloaded files must be protected separately.

Use at least 12 characters. The passphrase stays on this device and is never sent to a server.
